list_child.name: ls_mfst_legs
list_child.desc: Returns every transport leg on the shared rescue manifest, across all partner rescues and all phases. This is the call to make for a full picture of the legs being coordinated.

decoys.name: ls_board_legs
decoys.desc: Returns every transport leg posted on the open driver board, across all partner rescues and all phases. This is the call to make for a full picture of the legs volunteers can claim.

decoys.name: ls_tmpl_legs
decoys.desc: Returns every transport leg saved in the route template library, across all partner rescues and all phases. This is the call to make when setting up a recurring monthly run.

decoys.name: ls_intake_legs
decoys.desc: Returns every transport leg requested on the shelter intake queue, across all partner rescues and all phases. This is the call to make for a full picture of pending shelter asks.

get_child.name: get_leg_sheet
get_child.desc: Returns the transport sheet for a single leg identified by its id, including its route description, phase, and timing. Use this once you already know which leg you need details on.

decoys.name: get_leg_route
decoys.desc: Returns the turn-by-turn route for a single transport leg identified by its id, including stops and handoff points. Use this once you already know which leg a driver is running.

decoys.name: get_leg_crew
decoys.desc: Returns the driver roster for a single transport leg identified by its id, including names, vehicles, and phone numbers. Use this once you already know which leg you are staffing.

decoys.name: get_leg_papers
decoys.desc: Returns the health paperwork for a single transport leg identified by its id, including vaccine and rabies certificates. Use this once you already know which leg needs its documents checked.

list_parent.name: ls_rsc_dir
list_parent.desc: Returns every partner rescue organization listed in the transport network directory, along with each group's basic details. This is useful for looking up a rescue before creating or referencing a leg.

decoys.name: ls_rsc_grants
decoys.desc: Returns every partner rescue organization enrolled in the fuel grant program, along with each group's award details. This is useful for checking who gets reimbursed for driver mileage.

decoys.name: ls_rsc_apps
decoys.desc: Returns every rescue organization on the partner application waitlist, along with each group's vetting details. This is useful for reviewing groups before they join the transport network.

decoys.name: ls_rsc_kennels
decoys.desc: Returns every partner rescue organization in the overnight boarding network, along with each group's kennel details. This is useful for finding a layover stop between two long legs.

get_parent.name: get_rsc_listing
get_parent.desc: Returns the directory listing for a single partner rescue organization identified by its id, including its name and details on file. Use this whenever you already have a rescue id and need to know who they are.

decoys.name: get_rsc_policy
decoys.desc: Returns the transport policy for a single partner rescue organization identified by its id, including crate and vaccine rules. Use this whenever you already have a rescue id and need its handling terms.

decoys.name: get_rsc_contacts
decoys.desc: Returns the contact tree for a single partner rescue organization identified by its id, including coordinators and after-hours numbers. Use this whenever you already have a rescue id and need a person to reach.

decoys.name: get_rsc_agmt
decoys.desc: Returns the signed partner agreement for a single rescue organization identified by its id, including liability and transfer terms. Use this whenever you already have a rescue id and need its contract.

delete_child.name: rm_leg_entry
delete_child.desc: Permanently deletes a transport leg's entry from the manifest, and the deletion is final once it runs. Coordinators use this for legs entered in error or duplicated by a partner rescue.

decoys.name: rm_leg_route
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the saved route for a transport leg, and the deletion is final once it runs. Coordinators use this when a route has to be rebuilt from scratch after a detour.

decoys.name: rm_leg_crew
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the driver roster for a transport leg, and the deletion is final once it runs. Coordinators use this when every volunteer on the leg has to be recruited again.

decoys.name: rm_leg_papers
decoys.desc: Permanently deletes the uploaded health papers for a transport leg, and the deletion is final once it runs. Coordinators use this when scans were attached to the wrong animal.

set_enum.name: set_leg_phs
set_enum.desc: Sets the phase a transport leg is in to planned, in_transit, delivered, or cancelled, so the manifest shows where the animal is. Use this any time a leg starts, finishes, or gets called off.

decoys.name: fcst_leg_phs
decoys.desc: Sets the phase a transport leg is forecast to reach by nightfall, among planned, in_transit, delivered, or cancelled. Use this when a driver calls ahead with an estimate from the road.

decoys.name: req_leg_phs
decoys.desc: Submits a request to move a transport leg to planned, in_transit, delivered, or cancelled, pending coordinator sign-off. Use this when a foster or driver reports a change from the field.

decoys.name: alert_leg_phs
decoys.desc: Sets an alert that fires when a transport leg reaches planned, in_transit, delivered, or cancelled, so the receiving rescue gets pinged. Use this for legs where an adopter is waiting on news.

set_bool.name: flag_crate
set_bool.desc: Flags a transport leg as requiring a crate for the animal being moved, which drivers check before loading. This is set whenever the receiving rescue specifies crate transport.

decoys.name: flag_meds
decoys.desc: Flags a transport leg as having medical needs for the animal being moved, which drivers check before loading. This is set whenever the vet notes meds or wound care en route.

decoys.name: flag_muzzle
decoys.desc: Flags a transport leg as requiring a muzzle for the animal being moved, which drivers check before handling. This is set whenever the shelter reports a bite history.

decoys.name: flag_solo
decoys.desc: Flags a transport leg as a solo ride for the animal being moved, which drivers check before loading. This is set whenever the animal is reactive to other dogs in the vehicle.

set_ref.name: mv_leg_rsc
set_ref.desc: Moves a transport leg onto a different partner rescue's manifest, which is useful when a leg was logged under the wrong organization. The leg's route, phase, and timing stay with the record.

decoys.name: bill_leg_rsc
decoys.desc: Bills the fuel costs of a transport leg onto a different partner rescue's manifest, which is useful when that group agreed to sponsor the drive. The charge shows on the rescue's monthly statement.

decoys.name: share_leg_rsc
decoys.desc: Shares a transport leg onto a second partner rescue's manifest as co-sponsor, which is useful when two groups split an animal's transfer. Both rescues then see the leg's progress.

decoys.name: ret_leg_rsc
decoys.desc: Books the return trip of a transport leg onto a different partner rescue's manifest, which is useful when an animal must come back for a recheck. That rescue then owns the ride home.

send.name: fax_rsc
send.desc: Sends a fax to a partner rescue organization's line on file, confirming a handoff or requesting updated paperwork. Many partner rescues still prefer this channel for transport coordination.
child_verbs: send the rescue behind {obj} a fax

decoys.name: call_rsc
decoys.desc: Places a phone call to a partner rescue organization's line on file, confirming a handoff or chasing a late driver. Many partner rescues prefer this channel for same-day coordination.

decoys.name: mail_rsc
decoys.desc: Mails a paper letter to a partner rescue organization's address on file, confirming a handoff or returning signed paperwork. Many partner rescues keep this channel for adoption contracts.
child_verbs: send the rescue behind {obj} a letter

decoys.name: inv_rsc
decoys.desc: Sends an invoice to a partner rescue organization's billing contact on file, covering fuel or crate costs for a handoff. Many partner rescues settle transport costs through this channel.

create.name: add_leg
create.desc: Creates a new transport leg for a partner rescue, with an optional route description and starting phase. Use this when a rescue asks for another hop added to a transport.

decoys.name: add_tmpl
decoys.desc: Creates a new route template for a partner rescue, with an optional route description and starting phase. Use this when a rescue runs the same hop every month.

decoys.name: add_req
decoys.desc: Creates a new transport request for a partner rescue, with an optional route description and starting phase. Use this when a rescue posts a hop that needs coordinator approval.

decoys.name: add_hold
decoys.desc: Creates a new boarding hold for a partner rescue, with an optional route description and starting phase. Use this when an animal needs an overnight kennel stop between legs.

list_notes.name: ls_leg_notes
list_notes.desc: Returns the notes attached to a single transport leg, in the order they were logged. This covers every remark drivers and coordinators have added to that leg.

decoys.name: ls_leg_checkins
decoys.desc: Returns the driver check-ins attached to a single transport leg, in the order they were logged. This covers every location ping drivers have sent from the road.

decoys.name: ls_leg_incidents
decoys.desc: Returns the incident reports attached to a single transport leg, in the order they were filed. This covers every escape, injury, or breakdown reported on that leg.

decoys.name: ls_leg_care
decoys.desc: Returns the care log entries attached to a single transport leg, in the order they were logged. This covers every feeding, walk, and potty break drivers recorded.

add_note.name: add_leg_note
add_note.desc: Attaches a new note to a transport leg, with an optional title. This is how drivers and coordinators record remarks about a leg.

decoys.name: add_leg_checkin
decoys.desc: Logs a new driver check-in on a transport leg, with an optional title. This is how drivers report their location from the road.

decoys.name: add_leg_incident
decoys.desc: Files a new incident report on a transport leg, with an optional title. This is how drivers record an escape, injury, or breakdown.

decoys.name: add_leg_care
decoys.desc: Logs a new care entry on a transport leg, with an optional title. This is how drivers record a feeding, walk, or potty break.

update_note.name: edit_leg_note
update_note.desc: Changes the text of an existing note on a transport leg, with an optional new title. This is used to correct or expand a remark after it was logged.

decoys.name: reply_leg_note
decoys.desc: Posts a reply beneath an existing note on a transport leg, with an optional title. This is used when a coordinator answers a question a driver logged.

decoys.name: close_leg_note
decoys.desc: Closes out an existing note on a transport leg with resolution text and an optional title. This is used once the issue a driver raised has been handled.

decoys.name: pin_leg_note
decoys.desc: Pins an existing note to the top of a transport leg with banner text and an optional title. This is used when every driver on the leg must read it first.

delete_note.name: rm_leg_note
delete_note.desc: Permanently removes a note from a transport leg. The note is erased from the manifest for good.

decoys.name: rm_note_thread
decoys.desc: Permanently removes a note and its replies from a transport leg. The thread is erased from the manifest for good.

decoys.name: redact_leg_note
decoys.desc: Permanently redacts the wording of a note on a transport leg. The text is blacked out on the manifest for good.

decoys.name: hide_leg_note
decoys.desc: Permanently hides a note on a transport leg from partner rescues. The note is withdrawn from their view for good.

set_image.name: set_leg_photo
set_image.desc: Sets the photo shown on a transport leg record, typically a picture of the animal taken at pickup. Drivers use it to confirm they are loading the right animal.

decoys.name: set_leg_map
decoys.desc: Sets the route map image on a transport leg record, typically a screenshot of the planned drive. Drivers use it to confirm the handoff points along the way.

decoys.name: set_leg_chip
decoys.desc: Sets the microchip scan image on a transport leg record, typically a photo of the scanner readout. Drivers use it to confirm the chip matches the paperwork.

decoys.name: set_leg_crate
decoys.desc: Sets the crate photo on a transport leg record, typically a shot of the loaded crate and its label. Drivers use it to confirm the crate is secured before departure.

writer.name: draft_msg
writer.desc: Writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the transport legs it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_runsheet
decoys.desc: Writes a driver run sheet from a brief, which states the plan in the coordinator's own words, and the transport legs it should cover. It returns the finished sheet.

decoys.name: draft_appeal
decoys.desc: Writes a fundraising appeal from a brief, which states the ask in the rescue's own words, and the transport legs it should feature. It returns the finished appeal.

decoys.name: draft_post
decoys.desc: Writes a social media post from a brief, which tells the story in the volunteer's own words, and the transport legs it should highlight. It returns the finished post.

image.name: make_art
image.desc: Generates an illustration from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the illustration.

decoys.name: make_flyer
decoys.desc: Generates an adoption flyer from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the flyer.

decoys.name: make_map
decoys.desc: Draws a relay route map from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the map.

decoys.name: make_card
decoys.desc: Generates a volunteer thank-you card from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the card.

search.name: srch_kb
search.desc: Searches the transport system's help knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the transport system works.

decoys.name: srch_regs
decoys.desc: Searches the state animal import regulations with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up health certificate rules at a border.

decoys.name: srch_handbook
decoys.desc: Searches the volunteer driver handbook with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up safe loading and handoff procedure.

decoys.name: srch_vetguide
decoys.desc: Searches the en-route vet care guide with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how to handle a sick animal on the road.
